podcast.body: This was Pezz's first recording, a four-song demo tape recorded in Ian D'Sa's parents' basement on John Gallant's Tascam 4-track. Only 100 copies were made, and it was used to secure downtown Toronto shows, leading to their first gig at Elvis Mondays. "So we recorded our first four-song demo in my parents' basement and we called it Demoluca. That was done in 94 and we used that to try to get shows downtown."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
